content:
The goals for this week#This week my main goal was to deploy my website so other people could access it online instead of only running it locally. I wanted to learn how to deploy a Java backend using Docker and DigitalOcean. I also wanted to connect my GitHub repository to the deployment process, so it would be easier to update the application in the future.
What did i implement in the project?#This week I successfully deployed my backend to a DigitalOcean server using Docker. I used GitHub Actions to automate the process of building and publishing my Docker image, and I configured the server with the environment variables needed for the database and API. I also set up a domain with HTTPS so the API could be accessed securely online. Besides the deployment, I worked on integration tests, dependency injection and adding permissions to my endpoints.
The decisions i made in the project#I decided to use environment variables for database credentials and API keys instead of putting sensitive information directly in my code. I worked on separating my database dependencies from my routes to make the application easier to maintain and test.
summary: This week my main goal was to deploy my website so other people could access it online instead of only running it locally. I wanted to learn how to deploy a Java backend using Docker and DigitalOcean. I also wanted to connect my GitHub repository to the deployment process, so it would be easier to update the application in the future.

content:
The goals for this week#The goals for this week was to make relations between my entities and testing my DAO classes with integration tests. Since i learned about data integration this week i also wanted to implement that into my project.
What did i implement in my project?#In the second week of my project i mainly focused on fetching data from geminis llm API. Moreover i made sure to create relations between my entities and i made integration tests for my DAO classes
The decisions i made in my project#i ended up changing to the method readApi()’s parameter to a list instead of prompt String because i wanted the conversation between the user and the ai to be interactive. It makes the code a bit more complex but it was neccessary. I decided to have my record classes inside the APIReader class because it makes it easier to understand but i might change that later. I also decided to make a join table User_questions to deal with the many to many relation between user and question.
What are my goals for next week?#Next week i want to make my questions and subjects and put them into my database. I want to see if it makes sense to implement concurrency in the program since thats what im learning next week. I also want to optimize my readApi() method if possible.

title: My project blog week 2

content:
The goals of this week#The goals from this week was to put questions and subjects into my database. I have to find or mak the best questions and subjects for a datamatiker 1.sem student. This week i also have to improve my api reader class to make the conversation between the llm and the user interactive, because the user needs feedback on what they write. Since im learning about concurrency i will see if it makes sense to implement it into my project.
What did i implement this week?#week 3 i focused on chaniging the structure of my api reader class because i needed to make the conversation between the user and the llm interactive. I also found out that it would be smart to have a back up llm since the free gemini llm is not always reliable. That’s why i implemented a reserve llm in case of specific server errors like 429 or 408. i made a method called isRetyable() with all the status codes where it make sense to try another model. I also put questions and subjects into my database manually, and made my read api method interactive by putting all previous answers in a list.
The decisions i made this week#I manually put the data into my database which was 14 subjects and 58 questions. I decided these questions and subjects since they were made by a teacher of datamatiker 1.sem as a way to get ready for the exam. Looking back i probably could have used my program or even an ai to put the questions into the database, however putting them in manually seemed like the most simple way of doing it. I made a LLMException class because its got a boolean retryable so i can see if i should call on my reserve llm.
What are my goals for next week?#In the next week im working on another project so i might not do a lot on this project. However there is some improvements i can make like adding some new DAO methods and finding a better openAi model to use.
summary: week 3 i focused on chaniging the structure of my api reader class because i needed to make the conversation between the user and the llm interactive. I also found out that it would be smart to have a back up llm since the free gemini llm is not always reliable.
title: My project blog week 3

content:
The main idea of the project#The main idea of the project is a learning platform for a 1 semester datamatiker(software development) student. The way it works is i focus on having the learning objectives of the 1 semester divided into 14 subjects with the most relevant questions under each subject. So a user would click on a subject -> question and then a chat with an llm would start and the user would improve their knowledge on the chosen question. After talking with an llm about the question a checkmark appears on the question and the user should have a better understanding of the concept. So overall the flow of the program is: subject -> question -> llm asks question -> user answers question -> llm gives feedback -> question answered is true
What did i implement in the project?#In my first week of starting this new project i was mainly thinking about what features my program would have. I started out making a mental model of what i wanted and then translated that flow into a domianmodel. I Set up a simple database with user, question and subject. I then made those entities in java and then connected my java to postgres using the DAO design pattern.
The decisions i made in the project#This week i decided to have number of questions variabel in my subject tabel because it could be an intressting information later down the line. I decided to follow an interface for making DAO classes called IDAO where there is basic CRUD methods because it makes it so i create useful CRUD methods without thinking about it too much. Moreover its most likely going to save me time later down the line.
What are my goals for next week?#Next week my goals are the following. I want to make relations between my entities because its gonna help my understanding of the project. I want to set up integration tests for my DAO classes to see if everything is working.
summary: In my first week of starting this new project i was mainly thinking about what features my program would have. I started out making a mental model of what i wanted and then translated that flow into a domianmodel. The main idea of the project is a learning platform for a 1 semester datamatiker(software development) student.
